newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds held on to their slight opening gains in thin trade on Monday, with many investors staying sidelined ahead of Christmas.
Market players said they were not pessimistic on the outlook in the near-term, but added they could not give any forecast on the direction at the beginning of the New Year.
"We need new impetus to give a clue on the direction, but it does not look bad at all," said one.
Today's U.S. personal income and spending data were ignored by the market as they were more or less in line with analysts' expectations.
The January 2006 bond rose 0.12 to 102.02/10, with a bid yield of 5.71 percent.
The yield-spread on the ten-year Benchmark, the April 2006 bund, narrowed to minus 8 basis points from minus 10 on Friday.
